title: resolve_pane target parsing is dense without explanation
description: Lines 91-95: The parsing of `session:window.pane` with the implicit default of pane 0 when no dot is present is packed into a few lines. The `.rsplit('.', 1)` and `.split(':', 1)` sequence is correct but requires careful reading. A one-line comment like '# default to pane 0 if no .pane suffix' would help.
